name: branding-record-store-cap-and-arched-tote-bag
title: Record store identity on an embroidered cap and arched bag with pixel vinyl handle
whatItIs: A split photo: left, a cream cap with a blue oval 'FV.' embroidery on a wood cabinet beside a turntable; right, a person holding a tall arched cream paper bag whose cut-out handle reveals a pixelated black vinyl record and the word 'playvinyl'.
whatItMeans: Warm, retro and witty; the die-cut handle turns the bag into a record-sleeve object.
techniques: Integrate the handle cut-out with the logo shape (record).
Embroider a monogram in one accent blue on cream.
Use an arched top silhouette for the bag.
Shoot merchandise in a matching interior with wood and warm tones.

vocabulary.definition: A handle formed by cutting a shape through the pack.
A pictogram built from square pixels.
A shape with a rounded top.
